FIFA World Cup 2026: Balogun suspension controversy involves Trump, FIFA

The integrity of the FIFA World Cup 2026 has been questioned following the reversal of a controversial suspension for player Folarin Balogun. Donald Trump stated he only asked for a review, while FIFA President Gianni Infantino asserted the independence of FIFA's judicial bodies. EU lawmakers have called for a probe into FIFA's actions and a phone call between Infantino and Trump.
